title: [review] provisioning.py:602: Session leak in provision
description: After provision_node() successfully verifies the ACK (line 597), it returns the seed without calling _remove_session(). The session cleanup at line 599 only runs in the exception handler. This leaves the session in self._sessions indefinitely, causing: (1) memory leak, (2) cryptographic material (_prov_key, provisioned_seed) not wiped from memory, (3) potential DoS since max_sessions limit is not released.
close_reason: Fixed session leak: added _remove_session() call after successful ACK verification in provision_node(). All 83 provisioning tests pass.
